name: Large reciprocal weight under lcm separation
description: Return nonempty subset of [2,256] with lcm(a,b)>256 for all distinct pairs. Maximize exact reciprocal sum, not cardinality. Uses the reciprocal-sum objective in section14(1), with n fixed; pairwise lcm threshold is strict and the score is rational. The unit denominator1 is excluded locally to remove its isolated trivial certificate.
